profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer at Google

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led a project for migrating Php legacy page to Node.js page.
- Developed thrift micro services for multiple pages and email campaigns
- Php, Node.js, Apache Thrift, GraphQL

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Led a scrum team as team master and developer, creating a hybrid mobile app for mail gateway software within 5 months.
- Refactored mail server daemons and CGI codes thoroughly to support 64-bit environment.

Languages: perl, C, Javascript, JQuery, AngularJS 2.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and designed features for mail gateway software .
- Designed and implemented features for patch-packing process.
- Built a SVM spam filter prototype with 92.7% for positive recall and 92.3% for negative recall.
- Deal with web security issues during full-stack web development process.

Languages: perl, C, Javascript, JQuery.

positions.title: Second Lieutenant (Mandatory)
positions.description:
- Mandatory military service.
- Be in charge of two renovation projects ($200,000. scale).
- Negotiate with contractors and supervisors, calling up meetings, and dispatching workers to ensure construction quality.

positions.title: research assistant (visiting internship)
positions.description:
- Constructed a prototype field safety inspection tool (iSafe) on iPad to mimic practical field inspection task, and engages in user-oriented studies.
- Developed a 3D simulated training scenarios based on Unity, increasing trainees’ understanding as well as learning interests on topics of fall protection.
- Deployed field test with local workers to verify tool feasibility.
